description: Applies PII scrubbing, k-anonymity, and differential privacy to datasets.

inputs.name: payload
inputs.description: Text or structured data to be anonymized.

inputs.name: strictness
inputs.description: Level of privacy required (low, medium, strict, military).

outputs.name: privacy_guarantees
outputs.description: Metadata on applied noise, k-values, and removed entities.

epsilon_budget.description: Total privacy budget for Laplace noise injection.

epsilon_consumed.description: Cumulative DP budget used across transactions.

redaction_stats.description: Counts of different PII categories scrubbed.

metrics.name: pii_entities_removed
metrics.description: Total number of PII strings redacted.
